description.value: The Homestead Tofino is a self-catering oceanfront vacation home perched on a rocky point above Duffin Passage, a two-minute walk from downtown Tofino. The property sleeps up to 10 guests across five bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a private hot tub, fire pit, deck, and a dedicated storm-watch room designed for watching dramatic Pacific weather. It is managed by long-time Airbnb Superhost Cheryl, who has hosted international guests from this winter home for over seven years.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a self-catering oceanfront vacation rental sleeping up to 10 guests in five bedrooms, managed by Superhost Cheryl; the contact page corroborates the OSM phone number and website URL. The website explicitly mentions nearby restaurants supporting 'Nearby evening food,' but contains no reference to bike storage, cycling services, laundry, or e-bike charging; OSM's internet_access=yes is not confirmed in website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
concerns: No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the website.
Self-catering duplex with a part-time on-site manager; it is unclear whether anyone is available to assist with loaded touring bikes or e-bikes.
Booking interface displays EUR as the default currency, which is unusual for a BC property; likely a Lodgify locale setting but worth noting as a minor data-quality flag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate and apparently active accommodation in a cycling-tourism destination, but neither the website nor OSM tags provide any evidence of secure bike storage or cycling-specific amenities; direct outreach to the property manager is needed before including in the WWC directory.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states: 'Just steps away from an array of exquisite restaurants and the charming town center.'
